verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Codex is tied to OpenAI's own models (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark) and requires a ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key; there's no mention of selecting models from other providers (Anthropic, Google, etc.) within a Codex session. Community comments merely compare Codex to competing tools like Claude Code and Gemini, not switching providers inside Codex.
